$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the unified error model (plan/design.error-model.md). Edit here, then run `node scripts/gen-error-codes.mjs` to regenerate the JS + Rust mirrors; CI runs it with --check to fail on drift. Codes are a CLOSED set: stable, never renamed, additive only (like invariant ids). Each code has ONE fixed domain; the Fluent key is `${domain}-err-${code}`. `title` is a STABLE, per-type, operator/developer-facing English summary (RFC 9457 title; NOT the localized UI text — that is the Fluent message keyed by code). `args` are typed and drawn ONLY from counts/limits/seconds/enums — never request/user content. `retryAfter` is a top-level AppError field, never an arg. `action` is top-level, never an arg. Coherence rule enforced by codegen: a retriable code may not carry action 'contact'/'reauth'/'upgrade'.

below_gc_floor.title: Below the GC floor
below_gc_floor.note: write/read below the server GC floor; the client must bootstrap from a snapshot (409/410).

quota_exceeded.title: Storage quota exceeded
quota_exceeded.note: owner capacity gate; the numeric args are role-gated (F1) — only >= BILLING_ARG_MIN_ROLE (default Maintainer) receives them.

rate_limited.title: Rate limited
rate_limited.note: 429; carries top-level retryAfter (role-gated precision for non-owners, F1). Driver backs off; UI shows only if residual.

version_conflict.title: Version conflict
version_conflict.note: 409 CAS conflict; pull the current snapshot and retry.

covered_anomaly.title: Coverage inconsistency
covered_anomaly.note: client-produced coverage inconsistency (over-claim / regression / below-floor) — an internal invariant break the user can't act on.

head_rollback.title: Head pointer moved backward
head_rollback.note: 409: a heads/{replica} pointer PUT whose count is below the stored count (anti-rollback/griefing, OPE-411). The honest owning replica never lowers its head; a monotonic advance is unaffected.

invalid_request.title: Invalid request
invalid_request.note: 400 catch-all: a malformed/rejected write (bad envelope, wrong kind, id mismatch). Static detail, never library-error text (A3).

access_denied.title: Access denied
access_denied.note: 403: member exists but under-role / removed. Deliberately distinct from not_found (F2).

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.note: 404: the tree/object is absent. Deliberately distinct from access_denied (F2 existence distinction).

unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.note: 5xx / backend (R2/Neon/Lambda) down; collapsed server-side, never raw. Retriable.

request_failed.title: Request failed
request_failed.note: client-synth: fetch rejected (network/DNS/CORS). Honest label (C4); navigator.onLine may refine to 'offline'.

offline.title: Offline
offline.note: client-synth refinement of request_failed when navigator.onLine is false.

timeout.title: Request timed out
timeout.note: client-synth: the request deadline elapsed (C2). Distinct from request_failed.

auth_required.title: Authentication required
auth_required.note: 401 after one refresh, or no active session. Emitted by the HTTP adapter AND the auth seam — one code, domain follows the code not the route.

session_expired.title: Session expired
session_expired.note: the provider reports an expired/invalid session.

sign_in_failed.title: Sign-in failed
sign_in_failed.note: generic sign-in failure (wrong credentials, provider refusal).

sign_up_failed.title: Sign-up failed
sign_up_failed.note: generic sign-up failure. 'email already registered' maps HERE by default (F3, anti-enumeration).

email_taken.title: Email already registered
email_taken.note: RESERVED (F3): unused by default; the auth adapter's EMAIL_TAKEN_DISCLOSURE switch flips sign_up_failed → this for explicit feedback.

wrong_passphrase.title: Wrong passphrase
wrong_passphrase.note: unlock/change/recover: the passphrase did not derive the key.

tampered_anchor.title: Tree verification failed
tampered_anchor.note: the keyring anchor failed verification — out-of-date or tampered.

revision_rollback.title: Version rollback detected
revision_rollback.note: the anti-rollback watermark rejected an older keyring revision — a tamper/stale-restore signal, distinct from a wrong passphrase. Shared code across the web worker and the Tauri host (which already reports this code).

recovery_code_invalid.title: Invalid recovery code
recovery_code_invalid.note: the recovery code did not validate.

keyring_verify_failed.title: Keyring verification failed
keyring_verify_failed.note: a peer keyring/membership failed the verify gate.

storage_corrupt.title: Local storage corrupt
storage_corrupt.note: local store corrupt — needs a rebuild from the remote.

worker_unavailable.title: Background worker unavailable
worker_unavailable.note: the core Web Worker failed to instantiate (WebAssembly.CompileError/OOM) or went silent (C3).

internal.title: Internal error
internal.note: catch-all: an unexpected client-side failure (wasm trap, invariant break, plain-JS bug). cause is dev-log-only.
